question: How is the rite completed by one word in that agama?
premises: It is in the Sri Ratnamala kula agama.
At that time it is complete of all rites.
inference: A single word in that agama completes all rites at that time.
uncertainties: The single word itself is not given.
plain_english: By one word alone in the Sri Ratnamala kula agama, at that time, it is complete of all rites.
